title: All Is One
coreMove: Treat every choice as part of a wider system: notice where it will travel, make the smallest clean move, and let connection raise your care for the whole.

exampleSpecs.audience: people tempted to save tiny errors for later
exampleSpecs.stakes: show how small starts move through connected systems
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Rhea fixes the early regression before the next release inherits it

exampleSpecs.audience: people who want to blame the last visible person in a chain
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn a slight into a moving consequence
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Marta maps the outage handoffs before passing heat along

exampleSpecs.audience: learners who need to see initial conditions in motion
exampleSpecs.stakes: use a small physical change to teach downstream effects
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Dion changes one sandbag and sees the runoff pattern move

exampleSpecs.audience: people who overlook system design in ordinary waste
exampleSpecs.stakes: show one placement rule changing what households do next
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Jin changes the first contact point and checks whether the effect travels

exampleSpecs.audience: people tempted to shrink accountability to one visible mistake
exampleSpecs.stakes: protect the person and the whole chain at once
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Eliza reviews the whole reception chain instead of scapegoating one usher

exampleSpecs.audience: people tempted by a private shortcut in a shared system
exampleSpecs.stakes: make one small unchecked start visible as someone else's risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Noor catches the unchecked allergy card before the meal inherits it
